text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the old me would have said
that it was a deeply satisfying result...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...However, I believe that a hero is only called a hero once they have seized victory...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I want to be like that too...
I want to claim victory like a true hero...!
choice_data_list: Keep this up and you'll be just fine!
...In that case, let's take the harder road.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I believe that everything we've done together
wasn't a mistake...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'll build on this steadily
and seize victory next time...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The part where the protagonist takes on grueling training
is a staple of any story, after all...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I too believe that victory awaits
at the end of these hardships...!
